scope: General graph-level dissociation theorem for any successor-indexed word in the two local patterns with no adjacent A: every selected edge is internal to a block, and local dissociation gives global dissociation. Local pattern counts and boundary implication are kernel checked. Four conditional count implications check core/full word cardinalities, compulsory slack, cubic gap and exclusion of the proposed density. Cyclic word cardinal summation, full Heawood attachment and all-k upper-bound conjecture are not formalized here.
